amira: Quick summary from the bobcat-13b embed onboarding. Ran per-tensor int8 then per-channel + clamp experiments on semantic-suite v2 (50k). Per-channel + clamp recovered nearly all recall@1 lost by per-tensor quant. Short notes + links below.

sanjay: Paste numbers and cohorts?

amira: Median metrics (3 seeds): fp16 r@1=0.872 r@5=0.953; int8-per-tensor r@1=0.863; int8-per-channel+clamp r@1=0.871. Short-query (<8 tokens) hit reduced from -0.045 (per-tensor) to -0.009 (per-channel). Latency p99: fp16 42ms -> int8-pc+clamp 35ms. UMAP diffs: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/bobcat/4412345678-umap.png

marco: Sounds good. Any problematic layers?

amira: Layer blocks 10-12 showed tighter dynamic range after quant; local clamp there gave similar effect as global clamp=0.9. Command used: `rbw-quant --model bobcat-13b --quant-mode per-channel --clamp-layers "attn_out:10-12" --calib-samples 2048`

lina: Ops: reserve dedicated GPUs for canary test and run extended short-query holdout.

ops-bot: Reservation made: dedicated-ml-4, 3xA100, window 18:00-24:00 UTC, job rbw-8821.

sanjay: Proposal: canary 5% traffic on staging for 48h with stratified recall@1 by length and entity frequency; abort if short-query drop >0.7% or id-flip rate (k=5) > 0.5%. Lina/Marco OK?

marco: OK. Add NN id-flip fuzzing (50k samples).

lina: OK. Also collect silhouette_k5 and cohesion metrics.

amira: Will push canary config and artifacts to /artifacts/rbw-8821/4412345678/ and post links here. TL;DR: per-channel int8+clamp looks viable, small tail risk remains; canary + telemetry gates agreed. :rocket:
